_comment: Optional Hacker's Lair preferences. AI Workflow is enabled by default and scans only local workflow files; it does not scan agent transcripts. Legacy aiWorkflow fields remain readable for compatibility. Scripts are disabled by default and remain Windows-only. Panels can be toggled in Settings. browserPath may point to a preferred browser executable; leave it empty to use the system default browser. workspaceFolders may list absolute development roots to include in discovery and agent prompts.
